title: AC1021 TABLE value and attribute handle roles
scope: Apply ODA-defined TABLE cell reference roles, keep value/field references separate from text-style metadata, and verify wrong-role fallback and corrected retry.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
fields: The per-cell H varies between group 344 for text cells and group 340 for block cells; both are hard pointers.
Each block-cell ATTDEF reference is a soft pointer.
Text-style override is a separate hard-pointer slot controlled by the cell override flag.

changes: TABLE cell value handles now require a hard-pointer role; malformed roles leave the base entity readable and cell semantics incomplete per record-recovery policy.
Block-cell ATTDEF references now require soft-pointer roles.
A text-cell value handle remains in m_valueHandle and is no longer copied into m_textStyleHandle; the independent text-style override handle remains in m_textStyleOverrideHandle.
Legacy inline cell text is selected by the value handle's nullness.
generatedControls: AC1021 text cell: wrong soft-pointer value handle is retained only as incomplete fallback; corrected hard-pointer value handle and separate hard-pointer text-style override succeed on same-object retry.
AC1021 block cell: wrong hard-pointer ATTDEF handle is retained only as incomplete fallback; corrected soft-pointer ATTDEF and its string-stream text succeed on same-object retry.
implementation.result: Build succeeded; 1 of 1 focused tests passed.
